record.question: Which Indian operator soft-launched the Quantum 5G FWA described as the first Indian operator to offer indigenous 5G radio and SIM-less authentication?
record.explanation: Answer C: BSNL. BSNL soft-launched Quantum 5G FWA, described as indigenous and SIM-less with home-grown 5G radio. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2138086&lang=2&reg=48. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: October 2025 examination (cover page); answer time-sensitive wording as of then.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
